title: Spinorphin Ameliorates Nitroglycerin-Induced Migraine-Like Responses and Trigeminovascular Neuroinflammation Potentially Through Opioid Receptor-Mediated Mechanisms.
snippet: Enhancement of endogenous opioid signaling through inhibition of enkephalin degradation has emerged as a potential strategy for pain control, yet its role in migraine remains unclear. title: Spatial Transcriptomic and Proteomic Analysis Identifies Novel Immune-Associated Biomarkers of Anti-PD1 Response in Metastatic Melanoma.
snippet: Resistance to anti-PD1 therapy remains a major challenge in metastatic melanoma, despite long-term benefit in some patients. Since a functional dendritic cell (DC)-CD8T cell axis is essential for anti-PD1 response, biomarkers associated with this axis may help characterize underexplored immune states linked to resistance. title: Oncolytic Virus-Engineered Extracellular Vesicles Rewire Glioblastoma Immunity.
snippet: Immunotherapy with oncolytic Herpes simplex virus type 1 (oHSV-1) shows promise for glioblastoma; however, clinical benefit remains uncommon due to tumour- and host-mediated immunosuppression, which limits immune targeting of residual glioblastoma stem-like cells (GSCs). title: SRC Activation Drives Acquired Pemetrexed Resistance in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer and Is Targetable by Dasatinib.
snippet: Pemetrexed, a standard antifolate chemotherapy for non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), is often limited by acquired resistance. We investigated whether SRC kinase mediates pemetrexed resistance and whether SRC inhibition can suppress survival signaling in pemetrexed-resistant NSCLC cells.
